scientific_integrity: The first-order endpoint coefficients are known from Koroleva and Nikitin (2013); the proposed contribution is the explicit next correction for fixed n, positivity, and differing area/perimeter growth. Numerical quadrature is diagnostic rather than proof. Independent review not performed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed-n epsilon-to-zero asymptotic only; no uniform-in-n remainder or higher-order U-max distribution expansion. Accessible primary full texts inspected; the original Belisle (2011) and Wang-Xu (2018) texts were not available in full, so historical priority is provisional.
title: Positive second-order endpoint corrections for areas and perimeters of random cyclic polygons
